<a id="build_map_row"></a>
### [`build_map_row`](../../../../src/ground/map_row.asm#L6) `$4879`

*routine*

Builds the next map row when $407b is set. Stores the row address in $1200/$1280, then draws the row of the current feature $4035.

### [`build_map_row_plain`](../../../../src/ground/map_row.asm#L81) `$4901`

*label*

Draws a plain row. On odd rows, counts down $4058. At 0 the next airfield starts (feature 8).
